title: Home screen — the paper fan, the whole screen
question: Paper fan with today's schedule and the write-anything bar. Two ways to add colour. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Colour in the sectors
options.thesis: Each sector carries its own soft watercolour tint on ivory paper.
options.viewport: Fan, Today card with three rows and a gold day line, search pill, tab bar.
options.risk: The last sector still droops in the render; the build draws seven equal sectors.

options.label: Colour in the paper
options.thesis: A dusty sage-blue sheet with the fan, the day and the search pill as raised ivory panels on it.
options.viewport: Ivory serif greeting on sage-blue; ivory fan, Today card, search pill, tab bar.
options.risk: The strongest statement; a whole screen in one colour is a bigger commitment.
